# Reporting
# ---------
# Please include reproduction steps and the affected URL. I aim to acknowledge
# reports within 72 hours.
#
# In scope:     morganbarber.me and its subdomains
# Out of scope: volumetric denial of service, social engineering, reports
#               generated by an automated scanner with no demonstrated impact,
#               and findings in third-party services (Supabase, the CDN, the
#               registrar) which should go to those vendors directly.
#
# Please do not access, modify or exfiltrate data belonging to anyone else while
# testing, and give me a reasonable window to fix an issue before disclosing it.
